first-contentful-paint.title: First Contentful Paint
first-contentful-paint.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).

largest-contentful-paint.title: Largest Contentful Paint
largest-contentful-paint.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more](https://web.dev/lcp/).

total-blocking-time.title: Total Blocking Time
total-blocking-time.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive.

cumulative-layout-shift.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
cumulative-layout-shift.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport.

speed-index.title: Speed Index
speed-index.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated.

unused-javascript.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
unused-javascript.description: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required.

color-contrast.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
color-contrast.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. [Learn how to provide sufficient color contrast](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.9/color-contrast).

image-alt.title: Image elements have `[alt]` attributes
image-alt.description: Informative elements should aim for short, descriptive alternative text.

is-on-https.title: Uses HTTPS
is-on-https.description: All sites should be protected with HTTPS.

meta-description.title: Document does not have a meta description
meta-description.description: Meta descriptions may be included in search results to concisely summarize page content.
